def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # flipper length: coerce to numeric, invalid/negative values -> NaN
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    # body mass written as text (e.g. '3,075')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
    # sex label variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().replace({'nan': np.nan})
    return df

def answer(df):
    g = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm']).groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
